tools.name: ipapi_lookup_ip
tools.description: Look up one IPv4 or IPv6 address in ipapi.is: owner company, network, abuse contact, location, and the flags is_datacenter, is_vpn, is_proxy, is_tor, is_abuser, is_mobile, is_crawler. Spends 1 request of your ipapi.is quota.

tools.name: ipapi_lookup_asn
tools.description: Look up one autonomous system (AS number) in ipapi.is: organization, registry, type, country and announced routes. Spends 1 request of your ipapi.is quota.

tools.name: ipapi_bulk_lookup
tools.description: Look up up to 100 IP addresses and AS numbers in one ipapi.is request. The result is an object keyed by the entries you sent. Every entry spends 1 request of your ipapi.is quota. Duplicates and invalid entries are dropped silently by ipapi.is.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "ipapi_bulk_lookup" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.
